botcomponent.description: Use for any request that needs figures from the sales spreadsheets (Excel/CSV), even a single file or a single period - e.g. 'analyse Q4', 'how did sales do last month', 'compare regions', YoY/MoM/QoQ/YTD growth, top products, share of revenue, trends, outliers, currency-converted totals, or building/updating a consolidated master file. Finds and loads the relevant files, cleans and normalises them, computes metrics with standard definitions and edge-case handling, flags outliers and data issues, explains every transformation, and produces on-brand charts. Use this before the report or email skills whenever numbers must be computed. Do NOT use for questions that need no data (e.g. 'what does YoY mean') or for re-formatting results already computed in this conversation.
botcomponent.name: spreadsheet-data-analysis-reporting
